name: CelesTrak SupGP (multi-provider supplemental OMM) Data Source
description: Executable data-source: on a timer, ingests CelesTrak's PUBLISHED Supplemental GP (SupGP) OMM sets for providers whose raw operator ephemeris is NOT public (SES, Planet, Iridium, Telesat, Kuiper, AST, CSS). One token-parameterized adapter over a data-driven SOURCE-token registry; each object is re-emitted as a schema-exact SDS OMM record HONESTLY labeled non-independent (data_source=CelesTrak SupGP) with a distinct SourceName per provider, then signed + published as a PNM pointer. These are CelesTrak-fitted OMMs, NOT our OD.

timers.description: Periodic multi-provider SupGP pull (default every 2h; SupGP regenerates every 2h — 'no need to check more often'). Each cycle issues at most ONE query per registry SOURCE token; halts the cycle on any non-200 (CelesTrak M2M rule).

methods.description: Iterates the SupGP SOURCE-token registry (overridable at invoke); for each token fetches sup-gp.php?SOURCE=<token>&FORMAT=JSON (CSV fallback), parses the CCSDS OMM set, and re-emits each object as a schema-exact SDS OMM record with non-independent CelesTrak-SupGP provenance, a signed PNM, and a pubsub publish. One query per token per cycle; halts on non-200.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer published for each ingested SupGP OMM record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published SupGP OMM record.
